basic_info.description: Luxury living at its finest! Welcome home to Residence 23C at The Harrison. Enjoy this stunning home, where floor-to-ceiling windows showcase breathtaking and sweeping views of the Bay Bridge, water, and city skyline. The open layout is ideal for entertaining or unwinding, enhanced by designer wallpaper and refined finishes that create an atmosphere of sophistication and style. The Chef's kitchen impresses with high-end appliances, including a Bertazzoni range and Sub-Zero refrigerator, complemented by thoughtfully designed, ample storage. An elegant built-in wet bar and a private outdoor terrace with dazzling downtown views elevating the living and dining experience. The primary suite features a generous walk-in closet, dual vanities, bathtub, and a separate shower, while both the primary bathroom and guest bathroom have been accented with custom linen closets. Additional features include in-unit laundry, valet parking, and wine storage. The Harrison offers unmatched residential services and amenities, including a 24/7 lobby attendant, concierge, fitness center, pool, spa, BBQ area, and the exclusive residents' sky lounge Uncle Harry.
